integrity: All 18 pair-orbit cases have fully enumerated face sets and exact, independently replayed free-face/critical-facet peeling certificates. No claims of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive two-point-puncture classification for 3<=n<=6, not an all-n theorem. Distance-one rows already implied by Adamaszek–Adams Theorem 8. Hamming distances refer to the original cube. Candidate priority remains subject to unindexed literature. Complete finite Morse peeling certificates and independent verifier are embedded.
title: Two-point punctures of scale-two binary hypercube Rips complexes through dimension six
